comment: The section clearly locates clinical semantics and consent outside neutral transport. However, it may imply that all health-specific requirements are endpoint responsibilities. Shared health-sector services may legitimately provide terminology, validation, policy, or mediation functions.

anchor.note: p.74-75 l.Lines 841-854 read as the printed page; section 3.6.3 agrees

public.text: The section clearly locates clinical semantics and consent outside neutral transport. However, it may imply that all health-specific requirements are endpoint responsibilities. Shared health-sector services may legitimately provide terminology, validation, policy, or mediation functions.
public.suggestedRevision: State that health-specific capabilities may be provided by endpoints, shared DPI-H services, gateways, or combinations of these, while foundational transport should not be required to interpret clinical content.
